title: DC2 Rack-C ToR Uplink Flap
root_cause: DC2 rack-C ToR switch uplink LACP member flap caused intermittent packet loss and host reachability loss.
root_cause_tr: DC2 rack-C ToR switch uplinkindeki LACP member flap, ayni kabindeki hostlarda paket kaybi ve erisim kesintisi olusturdu.
resolution_action: Network ekibi rack-C ToR uplink LACP memberini resetledi ve hatali optic modulu degistirdi.
lessons_learned: Ayni rack icinde eszamanli network_down + pkt_loss kombinasyonu host bazli arizadan once ortak altyapi arizasini dusundurmelidir.

title: Billing DB Filesystem Exhaustion
root_cause: Archived redo/log files filled the billing database filesystem, causing DB write failures and downstream transaction timeouts.
root_cause_tr: Billing DB filesystemi arsiv loglari nedeniyle doldu; DB write fail sonrasinda billing, charging, payment ve order servislerinde timeout/txn_fail olustu.
resolution_action: Eski archive loglar temizlendi, filesystem genisletildi ve billing DB write islemleri dogrulandi.
lessons_learned: disk_full sinyali downstream transaction alarmlarindan once geliyorsa root cause skoru DB/storage tarafina yukseltilmelidir.

title: Session Service Heap Growth After Release
root_cause: A session cache retention defect introduced by the previous release caused gradual heap growth, GC pressure and OOM risk.
root_cause_tr: Onceki release ile gelen session cache retention hatasi heap'in yavas yavas buyumesine, GC pressure ve OOM riskine yol acti.
resolution_action: Session service rolling restart yapildi, problemli release rollback edildi ve heap kullanimi baseline'a dondu.
lessons_learned: Ani patlama yerine 60-90 dakikalik monoton bellek artisi trend korelasyonuyla yakalanmalidir.

title: External Payment Provider Degradation
root_cause: The external payment provider returned elevated latency and intermittent HTTP 502/504 responses, propagating failures to payment and order flows.
root_cause_tr: Dis payment provider yuksek latency ve aralikli 502/504 dondu; payment-service ve order-service uzerinde timeout ve transaction fail uretti.
resolution_action: Provider ile incident acildi, trafik kontrollu retry/fallback politikasina alindi; provider stabil olduktan sonra normal moda donuldu.
lessons_learned: Gateway'deki ext_slow/ext_unreach sinyalleri payment/order txn_fail alarmlarindan once geliyorsa dis bagimlilik root cause adayi olmalidir.

title: Reconciliation & Report Batch Window Collision
root_cause: Reconciliation and report batches overlapped after a delayed scheduler start, exhausting subscriber DB connection pools and CPU.
root_cause_tr: Geciken scheduler baslangici nedeniyle reconciliation ve report batch pencereleri cakisti; subscriber DB connection pool ve CPU tukendi.
resolution_action: Report batch durduruldu, reconciliation tamamlanana kadar ertelendi; scheduler overlap guard aktif edildi.
lessons_learned: batch_overlap sinyali DB pool/CPU yukunden once geliyorsa ortak DB arizasindan ziyade scheduler penceresi incelenmelidir.
